title: apricity-daw names: clip_file_name (section letter, length, key)
description:
## Intent
The naming rule as one pure function.

## Scope
- `crates/apricity-daw/src/names.rs`: `clip_file_name(clip: &SavedClip, sample: &apricity_score::Clip) -> String`.
  - section letter: the ML section clip (`tags` contain `section`, name `sec-<L><n>`, or `trio`/`intro`) containing the clip's start;
  - length: from the warp map, whole bars → `Nbar(s)`, else `Nbeat(s)`; none when unwarped;
  - key: `tonal.segments` weighted by overlap, else `tonal.key`; omitted below a strength threshold (constant documented in §Naming) — the threshold is named in the design note;
  - clip names already match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`, so file names are safe; still reject path separators defensively.
- Unit tests for each rule; the §Naming table in `design/daw-sidecars.md` lists examples identical to the tests.

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw names`.

Commit: `feat(<this id>): clip file naming with section letter, length and key`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
